summary:
All 14 acceptance criteria are met on this PC at HEAD d2620fc. Nothing under src/ changed.

**The SC-130 fix**
- Get-Missing now judges a guard-stopped arm before the interrupted branch. The interrupt suffix is worded from whichever marks exist.
- Every guard-and-interrupt shape in P-003's fixtures prints one line carrying the guard's reason and the /before-to-/exit net, or 'its net at the stop is unread (no X2/exit mark)' when /exit is missing.
- I made three mutants in scratch copies of the harness. Each one turns its case red:
  - restoring interrupted-first: P-003 fails 4 checks;
  - Get-Net back to [ordered]@{}: P-004 fails, NtfF 900 / Ntff 900;
  - Tag() with -eq instead of -ceq: P-004 fails, NtfF column 900 instead of 7.
- With -Report launched under Windows PowerShell 5.1, P-003, P-004, C-056 and P-001 pass. This closes code review's point that those cases never ran Get-Missing in 5.1.

**Unchanged report text**
- The 0feac0e comparison passes: 21 ok, with 7 cases equal line for line, P-003's first fixture equal, and C-011 equal by exit code and ok/FAIL counts.
- -Report over the committed build-2026-10-05 logs prints the same 8 lines from the tree under pwsh, the tree under 5.1, and 0feac0e.

**Other checks**
- The 10 fixture cases, the four SL-099 tests, the engine-TEMP run (TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP, scratch lands under LocalAppData\Temp), the Fitness check (90 rules hold), rules-parity, the rules harness and the full suite (805 passed, 0 failed) are all green.
- The rules harness (engine e90d02b) gives 124 rows, all AS-RECORDED, including S44-S50. One import rule is NOT RUN, which is already known (Q-131).

**Live runs on this PC**
- C-052, the shipped -Protocol -Rehearse path, passed in 268 s. The app was published and walked a 30,150-folder tree. Pool moved +2.9 MB paged and +1.6 MB nonpaged across the run.
- A second -Rehearse -Keep run wrote 45 marks. Every one holds all 29 watched names exactly once, case-exact, with no extras. NtfF/Ntff and NtxI/NtxF are separate entries with different counts. I deleted the kept scratch afterwards.

**Why contact is `real`, and its limit**
These runs read this machine's live kernel pool-tag table with the published exe. But they rehearse on a generated tree; they are not the session the record is for. No post-Restart cold C: protocol was run, so the outcome-C reading rule, F1 coldness (O-044) and cache survival (O-045) are unmeasured. Only a person's true Restart (session 1) can measure them.

**Not mine to judge**
I did not re-run the repro: the engine ran it and discharged O-001.

criteria.criterion: 1. Report a guard-stopped arm stopped by the guard, then interrupted during its settle wait after the exe exited (exit -1, killed false); /before and /exit present, no /settled (repro X1, P-003 arm (b))
criteria.how: P-003 fixture 2 prints for X1 'stopped by the machine guard (available 2900 MB, pool +310 MiB over X1/before): paged +310 MiB, nonpaged 0 MiB from /before to /exit; then interrupted before its /settled mark' on one line. Mutant M1 (interrupted-first) turns it red. It also passes with -Report under powershell.exe 5.1.

criteria.criterion: 2. Report a guard-stopped arm stopped by the guard and not interrupted, with all three marks present (control X2)
criteria.how: C-056's X1 has this shape (guard-stopped, not interrupted, all marks, a net row in the table). Its line 'stopped by the machine guard (...): paged +1 MiB, nonpaged 0 MiB from /before to /exit' has no suffix and is line-equal to 0feac0e in SL-099-ReportTextUnchanged.

criteria.criterion: 3. Report an arm the guard refused at start (guardAtStart cascade, guardStop 'available N MB at start', no /exit)
criteria.how: C-056 prints 'arm X2: not measured: guard already exceeded at start (cascade from X1)'. The guardAtStart branch stays ahead of the new guard branch in Get-Missing, and the text equals 0feac0e's.

criteria.criterion: 4. Report a guard-stopped arm interrupted before its /exit mark while the exe was being killed (killed true, exitCode null)
criteria.how: P-003 fixture 2 X2: 'its net at the stop is unread (no X2/exit mark); then interrupted before its /exit mark and killed'. The check 'X2, whose /exit mark was never written, prints no net' passes.

criteria.criterion: 5. Report a guard-stopped arm with all three marks written, then interrupted by a throw in the report read after /settled
criteria.how: P-003 fixture 2 F5: '...from /before to /exit; then interrupted after its /settled mark' on one line.

criteria.criterion: 6. Report a guard-stopped arm not interrupted whose /settled mark has a null pagedBytes
criteria.how: P-003 fixture 3 X4 prints the guard line with its +310 MiB net plus a separate 'mark X4/settled has no pagedBytes'. 'nothing else is missing (6 lines for 3 arms)' passes.

criteria.criterion: 7. Report an interrupted arm with no guard stop, either killed or after exiting 0 (P-003 F2 and F4)
criteria.how: P-003 fixture 1 prints 'F2: interrupted while FsAnalyser.exe ran; it was killed' and 'F4: interrupted after FsAnalyser.exe exited (exit 0), before its /settled mark'. The fixture's 34 lines equal 0feac0e's.

criteria.criterion: 8. Print a run report for every other fixture shape: C-053, C-054, C-055, C-027, P-001, P-002, C-011
criteria.how: SL-099-ReportTextUnchanged: 21 ok. Each case is line-equal to the 0feac0e copy after normalisation (random folder, scratch parent, PoolWatch.ps1:<n>, boot age). C-011 is equal by exit code and ok/FAIL counts. All cases also exit 0 in the tree directly.

criteria.criterion: 9. Compute an arm's net when $NetTags holds both NtfF and Ntff
criteria.how: P-004 loads Get-Net from PoolWatch.ps1 with $NetTags NtfF, Ntff, NtxI, NtxF and gets NtfF 7 and Ntff 900, with an Ordinal-keyed table. Mutant M2 ([ordered]@{}) turns it red with NtfF 900.

criteria.criterion: 10. Read a tag column when a mark lists Ntff before NtfF and NtxF before NtxI with different live counts
criteria.how: P-004 fixture half: F1's NtfF column reads 7, not 900. Mutant M3 (Tag() with -eq) makes the column read 900 and the case goes red.

criteria.criterion: 11. Record a live mark with the 21 watched names (7 WC leak tags + 14 added) case-exactly, some not live on this host
criteria.how: P-004's live half passes: 21-name literal oracle against the parsed $WatchedTags, and the always-live 10 against one Read-Mark of this PC. My -Rehearse -Keep run's 45 marks each hold all 29 watched names (the 21 plus the other WC and FM tags), once each and case-exact, read from this PC's live pool table.

criteria.criterion: 12. Run the harness cases under the engine with TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP
criteria.how: SL-099-CasesUnderEngineTemp: 16 ok. P-003 and P-004 exit 0 under TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP, and their scratch goes to C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp.

criteria.criterion: 13. Guard the harness's tag comparisons: case-folding comparisons on a tag fire, case-exact forms and $tag -eq $null stay quiet
criteria.how: SL-099-TagCompareRuleCorpus: 59 ok, with patterns read from fitness.yaml. Fitness: 90 rules hold with 0 hits on PoolWatch.ps1. Rules harness plants S44-S50 are AS-RECORDED. The spellings waived to SC-249/250/251 (capitalised operators, Compare-Object/Select-String, quoted or indexed 'tag') are outside the listed shapes and stay on the backlog.

criteria.criterion: 14. Record tags in a real run: a full -Rehearse run (C-052), with the app published and a 30,150-folder TEMP tree walked for about 5 min
criteria.how: C-052 passed on this PC in 268.3 s (RUN COMPLETE, 12 net rows, scratch swept and deleted). C-052 does not itself assert the tags, so a second -Rehearse -Keep run (251.6 s) was inspected: all 45 marks carry the 29 watched names case-exactly with no duplicates. The run was on a generated tree, not a measurement of C:.

obligations.evidence: The precondition is that F1 is cold. The code side holds: -Protocol throws when the boot is older than BootAgeMaxSec = 1800 (PoolWatch.ps1:54 and :729). The record lists it as must-verify (SL-099-outcome-c-redesign.md:119). Whether F1 is actually cold can only be seen in session 1, after a true Start > Restart and a whole-C: F1. Only the person can give that Restart, and the Sandbox cannot run -Protocol within its 1,800 s ceiling or measure this PC's C:. In the C-052 rehearsal F1 was not cold (NtfF +1 on a just-created tree), so it says nothing about this. What session 1 must show: F1's NtfF/Ntff/FMfn rise from /before to /settled far above I0's idle movement, of the order of about 1 per cold folder (about 670,000 folders on C:). This obligation should be retargeted to a person's session-1 check rather than held at validate.

The precondition is that the cache F1 builds survives to F2..F5. It is only measurable at whole-C: scale on this PC's memory (about 17 GB standby, 6 GiB guard, 3 GB floor), in session 1, which needs a true Restart. Supporting evidence only:
- Spike 107 in a 4 GB Sandbox: warm repeats NtfF +0/+0/+0, accumulation +4/+5/+5, P2 at exit + 600 s +1 to +3.
- This PC's C-052 rehearsal: F2-F5 NtfF +7/+1/0/0, FMfn +3/-1/+2/-53, on a tree that was already warm.
What session 1 must show: F2..F5 (the Completed ones after the first Completed F arm) net NtfF/Ntff and the 7 WC leak tags within the record (d) bound, Available MB never near the 3 GB floor, and no positive slope across F2..F5.

not_reached: Session 2 for DONE (c) under Q-178, Q-184 and Q-185: a second true Restart with dir /a /s per sibling root of C:, skipping the Layers store.

A live guard stop through Invoke-ExeArm, and a real Ctrl+C or error during a settle wait that puts guardStop and interrupted on one arm line. The SC-130 shapes were exercised only through hand-built fixtures; no live arm was guard-stopped or interrupted in either rehearsal. The guard-trip rehearsal is carried to the measurement-preparation slice.

Whether the listing cache is reclaimed at host scale (SC-231, Q-188), and where NTFS's close cache levels off on this 32 GB PC (SC-229). Both bear on the record's 'cache, not leak' reading and the 'no scanner change' decision.
Windows 10: no machine is available (Q-205, Q-216). Everything here ran on Windows 11 Pro 26200.

C-052 under TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP: the rehearsal still roots and sweeps under GetTempPath() (PoolWatch.ps1 rehearsal path). It ran here only under this user's LocalAppData\Temp; that change is carried to the measurement-preparation slice.
